subject.title: [Feature]:Add configUrl and configButton support in SKILL.md frontmatter

question: Should OpenClaw add a public skill configuration action contract, and if so what URL trust policy should the dashboard enforce for skill-authored configuration links?
rationale: Automation can prove the fields are missing, but it cannot safely choose whether arbitrary skill-authored URLs should become dashboard actions or how those URLs should be constrained.

options.title: Define a typed safe action
options.body: Add a maintainer-approved skill configuration action with explicit URL validation, UI labeling, docs, and tests before exposing it in the dashboard.

options.title: Reuse existing surfaces
options.body: Document `homepage`, Skill Cards, or ClawHub pages as the supported place for configuration links and do not add new frontmatter fields now.

options.title: Defer to plugin settings
options.body: Wait for a broader plugin-owned settings surface so skills/plugins expose configuration through one shared dashboard model.

recommendation.title: Define a typed safe action
recommendation.body: Add a maintainer-approved skill configuration action with explicit URL validation, UI labeling, docs, and tests before exposing it in the dashboard.

likelyOwner.reason: The current central files and adjacent UI URL policy history point to this owner as the best available router for the dashboard/security contract decision.
